as_told.title: Reagan at White House E.T. screening says it is true

plain: In 1982 the film director Steven Spielberg showed his movie E.T., about a stranded alien befriended by a boy, at the White House, and he says President Ronald Reagan thanked him and then looked around the room and said that "there are a number of people in this room who know that everything on that screen is absolutely true." Spielberg tells this himself in recordings played on the show, Michels recalls the audio, and the screenwriter Bryce Zabel repeats it from a Spielberg interview, giving Reagan's line as "about five people in this room." If Reagan meant it, a sitting president was hinting that some officials knew aliens are real.
